Name: Mystery Box Recolor
Author: kiwisprinkle
Description:
As small as they are, the mystery boxes just weren't doin it for me. So I made a bunch of new ones so that anyone with a similar feeling would be able to pick one they like that may match the aesthetic of their game a bit better! There's really not much to this mod, it's literally just the mystery boxes that change colors. I even made sure the little cutscene announcing them would have them change colors as well :D

[s]For now, this mod only affects the plain mystery boxes, not the golden ones. I might make recolors for the golden ones as well if there's any demand for it, but for now I hope you enjoy your new boxes![/s]
[b][size=3]Golden mystery boxes are now added!![/size][/b] They have slightly different colors in order to differentiate between the boxes a bit easier. Certain colors may still be a bit difficult to distinguish when put together though (such as yellow and gold).You can change the color option with the mod config menu or by editing the config file!

Big massive thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pokkki/about-me?gameId=1303]Pokkki[/url] for rewriting the code to be a lot less clunky!

Color options for regular mystery boxes are red, dark red, orange, yellow, green, dark green, mint, blue, dark blue, purple, dark purple, pink, dark pink, brown, and black. Default is set to red.

Options for the golden boxes are copper, iron, gold, iridium, radioactive, rose gold, black steel, ruby, emerald, diamond, sapphire, amethyst, and prismatic*. Default is set to gold.

[color=#f4f4f4][i]*when you break open the prismatic colored mystery boxes, they will cycle through the rainbow! happy pride month!! <3[/i][/color]
